CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff Liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff Liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff Liaison

  Wednesday, June 18, 2025 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst

  2. PRESENTATIONS – Paulina Ale, MHSA Program Coordinator, Tri-City Mental Health

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – May, 21, 2025

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program – Armando Cisneros
  b. Meals on Wheels Program – Armando Cisneros
  c. Bingo Report – George Borst
  d. Account Balance Update – Armando Cisneros
  e. Monthly Senior Program Fees – Armando Cisneros
  f. Mt. SAC Classes Update – Armando Cisneros
  g. Aging Next – Armando Cisneros
  h. Committee Terms – Yvonne Duran
  i. Facilities Report – Yvonne Duran
  j. Upcoming Events – Robyn Olsen
   5. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 a.m. on August 20 at the La Verne Community Center, 3680 D Street, La Verne CA
  91750.

Posting Statement: On June 12, 2025 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted on the
bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
www.cityoflaverne.org
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, June 18, 2025

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, June 18, 2025.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst,
  Jenny Jolly, Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: None.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Parks & Recreation Director, Armando Cisneros,
  Parks & Recreation Specialist.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Bette Donovan to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, May 21, 2025 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Paulina Ale, MHSA Program Coordinator, Tri-City Mental Health
  Presented updates on the focus groups held by Tri-City. The website has been
  redesigned to include new page “to get involved” by applying with a simplified
  application for meetings. More information may be found at www.tricitymhs.org or
  by calling (866) 623-9500.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 540 meals were served to an average of 26 participants in
  May.

  Meals on Wheels: N/A.

4. Bingo Report: Bingo receipts totaled $7,225.00. Ending balance in the
  account through May was $1,025.00 after $6,200.00 in payouts and expenses.
  Liabilities to Bingo West were $750.00. Liabilities to the City of La Verne,
  $235.00. The number of players in attendance for the month of May: 235.

5. Account Balance: $3,468.29.

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: Spring session will be ending on Friday, June 20th and summer
  session will begin on Monday, June 23rd.

8. Aging Next: Total number of La Verne Residents served for the month of April
  was 14 and total number of residents served for the month of May was 8.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Yvonne explained that there is a leak in the Dance Studio that
  is currently in the process of getting fixed. The Dance Studio may need a new
  air conditioning unit. New restrooms were installed at Las Flores Park.

10. Upcoming Events

  •  Friday, June 20th – Senior Seminar, Social Media Literacy, Presented by Embrace Health
  Insurance, 9:30AM.
  •  Friday, June 27th – Excursion, Santa Barbara Zoo and Downtown, 8:00AM-6:00PM.
  •  Friday, July 4th – Parade, 10:00AM.
  •  Friday, July 4th – Fireworks Show at Bonita High School, Gates open at 6:00PM.
  •  Thursday, July 10th – Movie Matinee, The Bucket List, 12:30PM.
  •  Tuesday, July 22nd – Excursion, San Juan Capistrano Mission and Historic Downtown,
  8:30AM-5:00PM.
  •  Friday, August 1st – Excursion, Summer fun at the OC Fair, 10:15AM-5:30PM.
  •  Friday, August 8th – Senior Seminar, Scams and How to Avoid Them, Presented by Embrace
  Health Insurance, 9:30AM.
  •  Monday, August 11th – Movie Matinee, Thelma, 12:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, August 13th – Senior Seminar, Preserving Your Memory, Presented by YWCA.

  Public Comments: Yvonne Duran stated that Veterans Hall will be adding a dog
  statue to the existing memorial statues.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:45AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, August 20, 2025 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
